executionFixes: Explicitly requested actions require corresponding same-run successful execution receipts before body, internal finish or publication. Reads and private self-notes cannot substitute for a requested personal memory save.
Read alternatives distinguish actually stored records from original current user reports. Calculation and navigation are included in the action catalog.
A no-change tool loader reports no added capability and cannot revive a withdrawn malformed tool or evade the existing no-progress guard.
Knowledge/analysis requests preserve reasoning on the current primary; only an explicit current judgment permits the guarded non-reasoning chat opening.
partialDeliveryFixes: Host/landed-write partial settlements preserve their partial outcome through durable checkpoints and finalization.
A failed evidence check settles before author/tool execution.
Partial answers no longer enqueue reply.finished or follow-up suggestions. Other initiative observations see the actual partial state and cannot replay that failed request.

matrixScope: Real HTTP, real models, actual development API/worker restricted roles after full role reconciliation. Source evidence/reasoning-field/reader changes made later require an updated task acceptance before release.

presenceConversation.scope: Actual 12s default propagated to container. No mandatory finish repair for ordinary chat. Quality improved, but provider and review tails remain; not full acceptance.

research.finding: The same provider/credential preferred index retrieved actual PubMed/PMC research in about one second where the basic index returned secondary/exam pages. Preferred index changed with fresh switch/consent checks and same-query alternate only on successful empty results; errors/quotas never invoke an alternate.
research.materialProgress: Receipts compare actual new/changed/repeated URL+snippet material; no fixed task-wide search budget.
research.v4AndV5: Both source-research attempts exceeded the 150s observer window and were cancelled by the isolated harness. They are failures, not successful or interrupted-by-hot-reload samples. Preferred index alone is not a verified latency fix.
research.latestWork: Typed HTTP/empty-body/interstitial outcomes preserve safe actual failure reasons. Reader distinguishes returned text windows and scoped original abstracts from full-paper coverage. v6 real research recheck is running.

localDatabaseRepair.scope: Existing development PostgreSQL only. Production database untouched.
localDatabaseRepair.failure: Recreated worker used its declared restricted role and exposed incomplete grants. Reconciliation repeatedly hung in CatalogTupleInsert/updateAclDependencies/_bt_doinsert; a debugger stack confirmed the loop.
localDatabaseRepair.repair: Stopped development API/worker and grant attempts, restarted the local server to end non-interruptible backends, reindexed both pg_shdepend indexes using PGOPTIONS=-P, then ran the full existing role matrix. Reconciliation completed in under one second; jobs SELECT/UPDATE and development readiness restored.
localDatabaseRepair.atomicBootstrap: apply-roles.sh now uses one psql transaction. An injected SQL failure in an isolated integration database exits 3 and leaves the full public relation ACL fingerprint unchanged. No additional table privileges were invented.
localDatabaseRepair.note: A pre-existing API-to-migrator role membership absent from the declared matrix was removed locally during diagnosis; removing it did not cure the loop. The effective restricted role matrix is the existing source of truth.
